vulnerable_statements.reason: link->link_enc is dereferenced without a NULL check. A link's encoder may not be assigned (e.g. with dynamic link-encoder assignment or links whose encoder has not yet been bound), so link_enc can be NULL and this dereference crashes the kernel (NULL pointer dereference).

suggested_fix: Check that link->link_enc is non-NULL before using it, e.g. `if (link->ep_type == DISPLAY_ENDPOINT_PHY && link->link_enc && !link->link_enc->funcs->validate_output_with_stream(link->link_enc, stream))`. Alternatively, get the encoder through the proper helper (such as link_enc_cfg_get_link_enc) and return an error status or skip encoder validation when no encoder is assigned.
